```{python}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

import framework as fw
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fw.scaffold()

# The query result is cached in cache/, so re-rendering while editing slides is quick.
visits = fw.cache_remember(
    "deck_visits",
    lambda: fw.db_query(
        """
        SELECT v.participant_id, v.visit_number, v.systolic_bp, v.diastolic_bp,
               p.treatment, s.site_name
        FROM visits v
        JOIN participants p USING (participant_id)
        JOIN sites s USING (site_id)
        WHERE v.systolic_bp IS NOT NULL
        """,
        "study",
    ),
)
```

## The cohort

```{python}
n_people = visits["participant_id"].nunique()
n_sites = visits["site_name"].nunique()
```

- `{python} n_people` participants at `{python} n_sites` sites
- `{python} len(visits)` visits with a blood pressure reading
- Two arms: control and intervention, up to four visits each

## Systolic pressure falls in the intervention arm

```{python}
#| fig-align: center
means = visits.groupby(["visit_number", "treatment"])["systolic_bp"].mean().unstack()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
for arm, color in (("control", "#7a7a7a"), ("intervention", "#1f6fb2")):
    ax.plot(means.index, means[arm], marker="o", color=color, linewidth=2)
    ax.annotate(arm, (means.index[-1], means[arm].iloc[-1]), xytext=(8, 0),
                textcoords="offset points", va="center", color=color)
ax.set(xlabel="Visit", ylabel="Mean systolic BP (mmHg)", xticks=means.index)
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.show()
```

## By site

```{python}
(
    visits[visits["visit_number"] == visits["visit_number"].max()]
    .pivot_table(index="site_name", columns="treatment", values="systolic_bp",
                 aggfunc="mean")
    .round(1)
    .rename_axis(index="Site at last visit", columns=None)
)
```

## How the numbers got here {.smaller}

The deck queries the shared database through the `study` connection in `settings.yml`
and caches the result:

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
visits = fw.cache_remember(
    "deck_visits",
    lambda: fw.db_query("SELECT ... FROM visits JOIN participants ...", "study"),
)
```
